risk_description: Improperly tightened rear axle components can result in loss or damage to the affected part (rod for the wheel and the chassis, brake caliper, rear axle fixing, ABS sensor, brake housing, brake housing support). This can lead to a loss of driving stability, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
